source.sampling: Cell centres, source row/column order preserved

sourceInformationScale.basis: Prior source lineage described in Xiaoma WZ-3D-KNOWLEDGE R0.1; not independently recovered from this integer archive
sourceInformationScale.note: Denser grid spacing and interpolation do not establish finer physical information or accuracy

surfaceContract.definition: Canonical surface from original 12.5m centre-indexed measurements. Bilinear interpolation on each original valid four-corner cell. Retained coarse samples and render triangles are approximations, not replacements of that surface.

domain.validity: All four original corners required; no extrapolation
domain.boundaryOwnership: Internal boundaries choose increasing-index cell; last outer centre boundary chooses previous internal cell
domain.continuity: C0 on shared valid edges; derivatives may differ

surfaceContract.physicalStatus: DEM-derived terrain estimate, not surveyed true ground
surfaceContract.discretization: Render triangles are disposable numerical evaluation; neither topology nor triangles are persistent knowledge
surfaceContract.normal: Derived from display evaluation, not a measured field
surfaceContract.missing: Unknown, not sea and not zero elevation
surfaceContract.patchComposition: Alternative approximations of one terrain model; patches overlap and are not separate physical objects

displayFrame.originRule: Patch horizontal bounds centre; vertical origin is archive numerical zero, not established sea level
displayFrame.viewOnlyScale: Optional 3x or 6x on y explicitly labelled; source measurements unchanged
displayFrame.resetPolicy: Restore alpha=1 and fitted camera of current patch

unknowns: Actual water versus missing source area
